label: TimeTree 5 pairwise divergence-time API (timetree.org/api/pairwise)
governance: Academic resource (Temple University, S. Kumar and S. B. Hedges labs). The /about page asks that TimeTree be cited as Kumar et al. 2022, 'TimeTree 5: An Expanded Resource for Species Divergence Times', Molecular Biology and Evolution 39 (DOI resolves, checked 2026-10-31). Terms on /about: data 'are provided openly for personal research and teaching use'; 'Redistribution of TimeTree data and its transformations are not permitted'; other uses require permission from info@timetree.org. There is no open licence; the vendored 'Free for academic use' paraphrase is roughly right but omits the redistribution prohibition.
versioning: Numbered releases (TimeTree 5, 2022). The pairwise endpoint /api/pairwise/<taxon_a>/<taxon_b> returns CSV with precomputed_age, confidence interval and all_total (number of studies); five recorded pairs re-queried 2026-10-31 returned byte-identical CSV and the same ages (e.g. Rhea pennata vs Rhea americana 11.440623865993 Ma from 8 studies).
known_issues: Redistribution of TimeTree data is not permitted by the /about terms, which constrains how the vendored ages may be republished (e.g. in nanopublications) irrespective of this assessment.
No DOI or version string is returned by the API; the record's 'TimeTree 5' label is inferred from the current release.
Divergence times are summaries (medians) of published molecular-clock studies, not primary measurements.
rationale: A peer-reviewed, versioned resource with a stable API and reproducible responses merits a high authority score, held below 0.9 by the absence of an open licence or query-level identifier. Independence is 0.6 because every value is an aggregation of other authors' published estimates. All five pairwise queries reproduced exactly and the citation on /about matches the DOI in the vendored record, so authenticity is 0.95.
